identities: Reuse all protected source/binary/fixture hashes in prior plan; verify actual bytes in exclusive private ledger before device arithmetic. Never overwrite earlier evidence.

contracts.accuracy: Same FP32 operands as prior standalone; independent double product/sum/subtract/product and P-transpose times dContext. dScores means dMaskedLogits. No scale, clipping, rescale or fixture edits.
contracts.candidate_softmax_fp32: Separate IEEE FP32 product, increasing-column serial FP32 sum starting +0, separate FP32 subtract, separate FP32 final multiply. Explicit rounding boundaries even if fused. No FMA or fast math.
contracts.candidate_dvalue_fp32: P[t,i]*dContext[t,j], increasing t=0..31; separately rounded FP32 product and add, starting +0; transpose0 true/transpose1 false.
contracts.higher_precision: Only if FP32 accuracy fails: double reduction on rounded products; then full internal double with final FP32 rounding. Each is a distinct candidate, not a change of gate.
contracts.standard_identity: Standard internal arithmetic unspecified. Models are hypotheses, never word certification of old QNN primitives.

controls.focus: F2/H0/G9/index32; compare each changed graph separately, no claim to see NoTap internal tensors

backend_search.audit: Fixed installed headers/examples/source only. Reject absent APIs; record backend rejection; no production change, no undocumented flag guesses.

selection_order: fused custom with explicit FP32 boundaries
candidate_search.development: All frozen core plus diagnostic controls; existing holdout is already observed, not a new unseen selection set
candidate_search.confirmation: Freeze chosen arithmetic and binary before three fresh independent full processes; no tuning against confirmation failures

custom_requirements: observed received operand/output words and timers
NoReceipt separate op without receipt computation
device_protocol: Fresh per-process existing strict safety preflight; same physical device; known top-resumed; awake; no training/competing QNN; SDK/APK/package/fixture/protected hashes; research battery policy; BACKGROUND_CORRECTNESS. Ordinary battery/temp/no external supply do not stop. Critical thermal/serious health faults/protection and unknown safety stop. No install/wake/unlock/foreground/force-stop/root/power changes.
native_entry: Both standalone accuracy and word gates, all four observers, fixed binary, fresh Forward P old joint gates, safety and production source unchanged. Single softmax, single dvalue before dual. Same P producer/ID per head, no Host reinjection. Separate ideal P, actual P, Host conditioned double, DSP consumer and total error. No full attention/layer claim.

cohort.digest: SHA256 canonical numerical identities and output words only; no time/counters/device/process IDs

negative_controls: Keep all old negative outcomes and incidents; never overwrite old FAIL with new candidate PASS.
stop: Host candidate fail blocks device candidate. Standalone fail blocks native. Observer fail blocks dual certification. Ambiguous internal precision does not block independently valid custom repair. Safety failure stops device work, continue Host. Protected mismatch stops without changing protected state.
